captions.detailed: A 2x camera teleconverter featuring a central black cylindrical body flanked by two grey metallic bayonet mount rings. The top front mount ring has rectangular grip notches and rotates, while the bottom rear mount ring is fixed. An internal black optical tube runs through the center.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a 2x camera teleconverter. It should have a black cylindrical central body, a fixed bottom grey bayonet mount, and a rotatable top grey bayonet mount with rectangular grip notches.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a central Cylinder primitive with a black material. Model the top and bottom bayonet mounts by combining concentric cylinders and subtracting an inner cylinder to create the hollow core. Add arrayed rectangular Box primitives along the outer circumference of the top ring for the grip notches, and define a revolute joint between the top ring and the main body.
